auth.note: A /api/v1 token from a test org. Eval traffic lands in api_access_logs under that org, which is why evidence_exclusions lists it.

models.why: Matches EVAL_MODEL's default in apps/web/scripts/verify-eval.ts so a demand-bank run and the in-repo golden run grade the same model.

evidence_exclusions.why: Eval runs and team testing are recorded with the same columns as customer traffic. Counting them as demand would make the harness grade its own homework.
evidence_exclusions.checked: 2026-10-25 against production api_access_logs. The first two are the built-in test tokens in lib/api-auth/validate-token.ts; the rest are the names production rows actually carry for MoxyWolf and test traffic.

inventory_input_contracts.IN-1: Finding set: rule ID (V-ID or SV-ID) or CCI plus status, from ACAS/Nessus, Evaluate-STIG, CKLB, XCCDF or eMASS
inventory_input_contracts.IN-2: Technology inventory: product plus version list
inventory_input_contracts.IN-3: Assessment scope / CUI boundary: prose or a system list
inventory_input_contracts.IN-4: Current assessment state: requirement ID plus implementation status
inventory_input_contracts.IN-5: Role roster: internal job titles, never names
inventory_input_contracts.IN-6: Contract obligations: required level and flow-down terms, prose
